verdict.rationale: Channel3 documents price-tracking subscriptions that send webhook notifications whenever a tracked product's price changes. That is a single, fixed event-to-notification trigger, not a general rules engine where users define conditions and automated actions. Any action beyond receiving the webhook has to be built by the user. Missing for 10: user-definable rule conditions (e.g., price thresholds, stock changes), event types beyond price changes, configurable automated actions beyond webhook delivery, in-depth docs on the subscription and rule model, independent or hands-on corroboration.
